mechanism: Bumetanide-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia can potentiate QT prolongation risk with escitalopram, and loop diuretics may increase escitalopram levels through volume depletion and altered renal clearance.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly, assess QTc interval if risk factors present, and maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative diuretic if significant electrolyte abnormalities develop.
